module: Flowgraph node "Traffic Driving Stats" (once_p_duration). Tracks the road and driving behavior of a vehicle (vehId, otherwise the player vehicle) with gameplay/traffic/roadTracking. Outputs: n1/n2 (road nodes), roadOffset, roadXnorm/roadYnorm, speedRatio (speed / limit), collisions, faultOverSpeed/WrongWay/Reckless (0 to 1) and associated timers.

onNodeReset.desc: Forgets the vehicle and the current tracking.

work.desc: Creates or updates the roadTracking object for the vehicle (onUpdate with dtSim) and copies its values to the outputs.
